name: Nagarjuna
shortBio: Founder of the Madhyamaka ('Middle Way') school of Mahāyāna Buddhism; demonstrated through rigorous reductio ad absurdum (prasaṅga) that all phenomena are empty (śūnyatā) of intrinsic essence (svabhāva) due to dependent origination.
centralQuestion: How does dependent origination dissolve metaphysical absolutes while preserving conventional truth and ethical action?

keyWorks.title: Mulamadhyamakakarika (Fundamental Verses on the Middle Way)
keyWorks.description: Foundational treatise of Madhyamaka, dismantling metaphysical concepts of causation, motion, identity, and essence through relentless dialectic.

keyWorks.title: Vigrahavyavartani (The Dispeller of Objections)
keyWorks.description: Epistemological masterwork defending the Madhyamaka method against Nyāya realist accusations of self-refuting nihilism.
